title: XBOX 25th Anniversary Celebrations Are Coming To McDonald’s, and In-Game Rewards Are On The Menu_copy
author: A New UK Incentive
paragraph_1: As part of XBOX 25th Anniversary celebrations, some of the biggest XBOX titles are launching McDonald’s game-inspired menu items as part of the celebration.
paragraph_2: McDonald’s is partnering with XBOX as part of its 25th anniversary to offer in-game rewards for some of the brand’s most recognizable gaming franchises. These franchises include Halo, Fallout, and Forza. Blizzard Entertainment properties (being that they’re an XBOX property now) are joining the equation with World of Warcraft, Candy Crush and Overwatch to round out the ensemble at McDonald’s.
paragraph_3: SVP, chief marketing officer for McDonald’s UK and Ireland, Tim Kenward, says, “Gaming is all about imagination and the worlds we love to get lost in,” adding, “What excites me about this partnership is that we’re bringing parts of these iconic gaming worlds to life, giving fans the chance to experience food they have only ever seen on screen. As a huge Fallout fan, I’m most excited for the Blamco Cheesy Potato Bites.”

title: Buwan Ng Wika: Lingua Narrative Celebration 2026_copy
author: South East Asia Aesthetic
paragraph_1:
Buwan ng Wika is a celebration of the diverse cultures and languages of the Philippines. Let’s celebrate and recognize talented developers from across the world through rich, narrative-driven games and localized titles that embrace the spirit of “Lingua Franca.”

Buwan ng Wika: Lingua Narrative Celebration 2026 is a Steam event hosted by SEAGamethetic, featuring games with localization and a strong focus on narrative elements.

The event will run from August 11 to 16 2026.
